update.name: Skill Differential Logging System
update.context: Farkle Frenzy uses a sweepstakes PDX model (1:1 USD prize-eligible currency). To legally defend skill predominance classification under state AG scrutiny, the server must log per-session and per-decision analytics from day one. This data proves that skilled players consistently outperform random play — the core legal requirement for the predominance test. Stack: React 19 + TypeScript strict + Express v5 + Supabase + Node 25.x. Monorepo: packages/shared, packages/engine, apps/client, apps/server.

dependencies.dep: apps/server/src/gameRoom.ts — E1 patch will consume this

file.description: Pure computation module. No side effects. No imports from apps/. Exports three functions used by server to evaluate every player decision.

constraints.constraint: TypeScript strict mode. No any. No unknown without narrowing.
No Math.random(). Pure deterministic functions only.
Export SessionAnalytics and ChainDecision interfaces — they are consumed by apps/server.

file.description: Supabase insert/query wrappers for session_analytics and chain_decisions tables. Called by gameRoom.ts on every chain decision and session end.

constraints.constraint: Analytics inserts are fire-and-forget. Never block the game loop.
Use SUPABASE_SERVICE_KEY (not anon key) — writes require service role.
All functions wrapped in try/catch. Errors logged, never thrown.
No sql.js here — Supabase REST only. sql.js is for local session storage only.

do-not.rule: Do not use better-sqlite3. Supabase REST only for analytics.
Do not await analytics inserts in the game hot path.
Do not import from framer-motion. Use motion/react.
Do not modify farkleScorer.ts — skill metrics are separate from scoring.
Do not regenerate SpawnPool class — SixPoolManager is the pool implementation.
Do not add activeBombs array — bombs are Cell.type values in the grid.

verification.check: npx tsc --noEmit returns 0 errors after applying
SessionAnalytics and ChainDecision are importable from @farkle/engine/skillMetrics
insertChainDecision does not throw when Supabase is unreachable
isOptimalDecision returns true for BANK when farkleRisk is 0.9
